description: SEC Filing Integrity Check: XBRL Footing, Tie-Outs, Revisions — Before a figure from a US 10-K or 10-Q is quoted, re-checks it with exact integer arithmetic on SEC XBRL data: balance sheet identity (including noncontrolling and temporary equity), net income bridge, cash flow to balance sheet cash tie-out with restricted cash and roll-forward, EPS recomputation, every calculation-linkbase relationship the filing declares, and same-period values that a later 10-

accession.description: Accession number of a 10-K or 10-Q, e.g. 0000320193-25-000079. Give this or fiscal_year with period.

checks.description: Checks to run; default all six.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year of the filing's DocumentFiscalYearFocus.

period.description: FY selects the 10-K; Q1 to Q3 select 10-Qs (there is no Q4 filing).

rounding_mode.description: exact: any nonzero difference fails. reported_precision (default): differences within half a unit of the filing's reporting scale per rounded figure pass and are flagged.

ticker.description: Exchange ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. Give exactly one of ticker or cik.

name: filing-integrity-check
